title: Variable Information Data Layouts
applicability: Applies conditionally through Variable Information Segment 111 when Segment 100 transaction/card/merchant context requires a variable-information Table ID.

businessRequirements.title: A Segment 100 transaction requiring Variable Information shall include Segment 111 in Data Section 3 and Element 63 shall include it in the serialized count.
Variable Information Segment 111 shall use the Table ID defined for the applicable transaction/card/merchant context.
Variable Information Table Length and Table Data shall respect the source-defined layout and maximum length for the selected Table ID.
Variable Information data shall be consistent with Segment 100 Prompt Code, card type, entry mode, transaction flow, and merchant configuration.
When Terminal Identifier uses the Appendix D non-US/non-Canada state-code condition, Variable Information Table 041 shall carry the country subdivision data required by the source.

testCases.positive: Required Table 111 is present and counted
Table ID, length, and data match a defined Appendix I layout
Variable data agrees with Prompt Code and flow
negative: Variable table conflicts with card/transaction context

testCases.positive: Table 041 accompanies the non-US/non-Canada terminal condition

testDataStatus: Segment 111 trigger and Element 63 compatibility are covered; full Appendix I table enumeration is not yet implemented.
remaining: Review Appendix I table families one by one where Segment 100 transaction/card contexts use them.
